rationale_one_line: Numbers carry the story (100 experiments overnight, 5-minute budget, 82k stars), and the dark-steel subway-chrome surface reads as the all-night compute room the project lives in.
writing_tone_notes: Karpathy voice. Compressed, declarative, one-clause sentences. Use contractions. Show contrasts, never adjectives. Lean on concrete nouns: train.py, val_bpb, 5 minutes, 100 runs. No frontier-lab gloss. Treat the reader as a builder who already knows nanochat.
do_rules: Open the first scene with a concrete number, not a positioning line
Land at least one big_number scene with 100 and one with 12/hour or 5 min
Use lowercase where the preset case rule says so
Keep technical handle (val_bpb) in body once for credibility
dont_rules: No paraphrase of the meat-computers line in the video itself (save flavor for the dossier; tribute is its own voice)
No repetition of 82k stars across the X caption AND the Why-this-one
